title: Dan Ige Ready To Rebrand Himself As ‚Äú100 Grand‚Äù At UFC Houston - NewsBreak
text:
By Pavan Sharma ,
53 minutes ago
Dan Ige (Image Credits: Imagn Images) Fans were shocked when Dan Ige stepped in on 3-4 hours of short notice against Diego Lopes. Meanwhile, his short-notice fight was so close that fans now always wonder how he will perform with a full camp. And this weekend, he is stepping in with a full camp against Melquizael Costa. Ige is aiming not only to win this fight but also to rebrand himself.
UFC Houston is a stacked Fight Night , and fans must be looking at the main card closely as many fighters will climb up in their division. However, the 34-year-old fighter is revealing he will use the stage to change his nickname, which will be officially changed from ‚Äú 50K ‚Äù to ‚Äú 100 Grand ‚Äù Dan Ige this Saturday night at UFC Houston.
‚ÄúI guess it‚Äôll be official Saturday, but, yes. If it‚Äôs Bruce Buffer announcing it‚Äôll be 100 grand, Dan Ige,‚Äù Ige said in the pre-fight press conference.
Previously, the UFC used to pay a $50K bonus. But now, under the Paramount deal, the promotion offers a $100K bonus . This might be the reason the featherweight star is changing his nickname. However, fans will be more interested in seeing him fight.
Dan Ige vs. Melquizael Costa Fight Preview Dan Ige (Image Credits: Imagn Images) Ige is aiming to climb up the featherweight division, and he will face Melquizael Costa at UFC Houston. The 34-year-old fighter has lost three of his last five fights and now holds a record of 19 wins and 10 losses. Whereas Costa is on a five-fight win streak now.
He has produced one of the best knockouts in the UFC and holds a 25-7 record. Both fighters have top-notch striking, and fans will see thrilling back-and-forth action. The main card is fully stacked at UFC Houston. But the question remains: can Ige bounce back from his losses? Or will he see another setback? Time will tell.
